instruction: I am organizing a get-together for my coworkers this Saturday night. I need to buy a return gift for everyone who has RSVPed yes on email. Buy a gift-wrapped 'Ticket to Ride Board Game' for each of them on amazon, and have them delivered to my home.
notes: Apps: supervisor, gmail, amazon (file_system/gmail record changes in the evaluation are side effects of placing the order, not agent calls). The number of gifts is a runtime quantity object (quantity-rsvp-yes) obtained by reading the get-together email thread and counting the coworkers who replied yes; static facts thread-query/rsvp-count-of/product-query tie the query objects to the records they discover. The cart is cleared before adding the product so the order contains exactly N units, and add_gift_wrapping_to_product is called with the same quantity so gift_wrap_quantity == ordered_quantity == N. supervisor.show_addresses reveals the home address; amazon.show_addresses yields its amazon address_id (if the home address is absent on amazon, amazon.add_address with the supervisor's home address fields would be needed before place_order, which the evaluation tolerates). If RSVP replies span several threads, gmail.show_thread is repeated per thread and the total yes-count is used. supervisor.complete_task carries the order record parameters (non-API) so its precondition is exactly the goal condition; it is the only action that sets task-completed and is forced last.
